# EO:393: Order of the President, Jan. 12, 1906, revoking order authorizing temporary appointments on the Isthmus 67 (contents entry 35)
# Source: Executive Orders Relating to the Isthmian Canal Commission, March, 1904, to June 12, 1911, inclusive (Washington: Government Printing Office, 1911); University of Florida copy (gift of the Panama Canal Museum); HathiTrust handle 2027/ufl1.ark:/13960/t3dz15k02
# PDF: releases/source_books/Isthmian_Canal_Commission_Executive_Orders_1904-1911_ufl1.ark+=13960=t3dz15k02.pdf sha256 4151116ad1c3ae8b08a9216f8591ca14e0d71ef20805c9250405d88aa6365eda
# PDF pages 80-80; printed pages 67-67; date 1906-01-12 (contents); body date check white_house_strict; confidence high
# Identity: EO number from the committed crosswalk (the volume prints none): EO:393
# Text: OCR text layer of the scan (pypdf 6.20.1 extract_text(), one JSON line per PDF page, NUL characters removed; the layer is the scan's own OCR), running heads and GPO footers removed. Not human-verified. Body sha256 c329e88d77565dcb037159343c4c8d1a1993447ccf9f7450dd1f99123429b36e

Executive Order of November 15, 1905, as to appointments to
positions in the service of the Isthmian Canal Commission upon the
Isthmus of Panama, is hereby repealed.
Theodore Roosevelt.
The White House, January 12, 1906.
